description: This file defines a UI component class 'ToolExecutionComponent' for rendering tool execution status, results, and details in a terminal UI, including methods for updating display based on tool output and state.

classes.name: ToolExecutionComponent
classes.description: A UI component class for displaying the status, output, and details of a tool execution within a terminal interface.

methods.name: setArgs
methods.description: Updates the arguments for the tool and refreshes the display.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Sets whether the output is expanded or collapsed and refreshes the display.

methods.name: setResult
methods.description: Sets the tool result, updates error state, and refreshes the display.

methods.name: setPartialResult
methods.description: Sets a partial result and updates the display accordingly.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on current state, including background, title, arguments, and output text.
